VM syscall macros for CU charging and virtual-to-host memory translation.

# Purpose
This header defines helper macros and one small data structure for VM syscall code. The `FD_VM_CU_UPDATE` and `FD_VM_CU_MEM_OP_UPDATE` macros charge compute units and return `FD_VM_SYSCALL_ERR_COMPUTE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED` when the VM does not have enough budget. The memory macros translate VM virtual addresses to host addresses for load and store access, check size and alignment rules, record access violation data in `fd_vm_t`, and return `FD_VM_SYSCALL_ERR_SEGFAULT` on failure. The `fd_vm_haddr_query_t` type and `FD_VM_TRANSLATE_MUT` macro support translation of multiple mutable regions and reject overlapping host address ranges.
